description: This Java class 'XYData' manages a collection of 2D data points organized by X values, supporting operations like adding points, retrieving data, and saving to a file. It appears to be part of a data visualization or logging system.

classes.name: XYData
classes.description: Class for managing XY coordinate data points with methods for adding, retrieving, and saving data.

methods.name: XYData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the XYData object and clearing data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the Z value for given X and Y coordinates.

methods.name: getMaxXValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum X value recorded.

methods.name: getMinXValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum X value recorded.

methods.name: getMaxYValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum Y value recorded.

methods.name: getMinYValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum Y value recorded.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a data point with RPM, key (X), and value (Z).

methods.name: setPoint
methods.description: Sets a data point at specified coordinates.

methods.name: getYdata
methods.description: Retrieves or creates YAxisData for a given Point3D.

methods.name: getXSet
methods.description: Returns a navigable set of all X values.

methods.name: getYAxis
methods.description: Retrieves or creates YAxisData for a specific X value.

methods.name: findYAxis
methods.description: Finds YAxisData closest to a given X value.

methods.name: findXfromSet
methods.description: Finds the closest X value in the set to a given X.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all data and min/max values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the XYData object.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves all YAxisData to a file with a timestamped filename.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the data with a grid of points over specified RPM and key ranges.
